newsitem.title: FRANCE: French porn suspect cites single European market.
newsitem.headline: French porn suspect cites single European market.

text.p: A Frenchman charged with posession of child pornography pleaded not guilty on Thursday, saying he bought kiddy-porn videos legally in Germany and citing the single European Union market.

Alain M., 32, told a court in Saint-Gaudens, near Toulouse: "I bought these pornographic cassettes in Germany believing that if they were freely on sale there, I could possess them here. Otherwise, it makes a nonsense of Europe."

The public prosecutor said it was "a danger for our society if men can freely possess such atrocities on video", saying that adolescents from eastern Europe were lured into appearing in such films with promises of movie careers.
The court will give its verdict on April 24.
